questions.question_hindi: स्टेशन बदलने वाले प्रतिनियुक्ति आदेश पर कर्मचारी को दूसरे सरकारी विभाग में भेजा जाए, तो स्थानांतरण TA का खर्च सामान्यतः कौन उठाता है?

दोनों विभाग बराबर-बराबर

questions.question_english: When an employee is sent on deputation to another government department involving a change of station, who generally bears the cost of the Transfer TA?

Split equally between both departments
The borrowing department
The employee bears the cost personally
questions.explanation_english: The borrowing department When a government servant is transferred on deputation to another department involving a change of station, Transfer Travelling Allowance expenses are borne by the borrowing department, as the transfer serves the administrative requirements of the receiving organization responsible for the post during deputation tenure.

options_hindi: LTC में आधिकारिक दौरे की तुलना में ऊँची यात्रा-श्रेणी मिलती है
आधिकारिक दौरे के TA में दैनिक भत्ता शामिल है, जबकि LTC में DA नहीं मिलता

questions.question_english: According to the Travelling Allowance Rules cross- referencing Leave Travel Concession (LTC), what is the primary difference in entitlement between TA on Tour and LTC travel?
options_english: LTC allows a higher class of travel compared to official TA on tour
TA on tour includes Daily Allowance, whereas LTC strictly excludes DA
LTC permits reimbursement of local taxi fares, whereas TA on tour does not
TA on tour restricts family travel, whereas LTC restricts self travel
questions.explanation_english: TA on tour includes Daily Allowance, whereas LTC strictly excludes DA The principal structural difference between Travelling Allowance on tour and Leave Travel Concession lies in Daily Allowance. TA on tour provides Daily Allowance for meals, local travel, and lodging, whereas LTC strictly reimburses journey fares while excluding Daily Allowance or incidental expenses incurred during travel leave.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है: आधिकारिक दौरे के TA में दैनिक भत्ता शामिल है, जबकि LTC में DA नहीं मिलता। निजी सामान के परिवहन और LTC दावों में निर्धारित समय-सीमा, पात्र किराया तथा आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ लागू होते हैं।

100% of Basic Pay
120% of Basic Pay

questions.explanation_english: 100% of Basic Pay Under the 7th CPC TA Rules, while the standard Composite Transfer Grant is eighty percent of Basic Pay, transfers to or from island territories (such as Andaman & Nicobar or Lakshadweep) entitle the employee to a higher CTG rate of 100% of Basic Pay due to geographical hardship.

questions.question_english: What is the rule for Travelling Allowance when an employee is transferred from one office to another office within the same building?
options_english: Admissible at 1/3rd rate for internal office shifting
No TA/CTG is admissible (no change of station/residence)
A fixed allowance of Rs. 1000 is paid for shifting
Full CTG is given as an administrative incentive for transfer
questions.explanation_english: No TA/CTG is admissible (no change of station/residence) Transfer Travelling Allowance and Composite Transfer Grant are intended to compensate relocation expenses when shifting headquarters or residence. Transferring between offices within the same building involves no change of station or residence, making TA and CTG completely inadmissible under Central Civil Services transfer travel guidelines.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है: स्टेशन या निवास नहीं बदलने पर TA/CTG देय नहीं है। नियंत्रण अधिकारी को यात्रा की अनुमति, जनहित, वास्तविक खर्च और लागू नियमों की पुष्टि करनी चाहिए; गलत दावे पर अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई हो सकती है.

options_english: Up to 50% of total estimated expenses
Up to 75% of total estimated expenses
Up to 80% of total estimated expenses
Up to 100% of estimated expenditure
questions.explanation_english: Up to 100% of estimated expenditure Under General Financial Rules and Travelling Allowance regulations, a government servant proceeding on an official tour may be granted a TA advance of up to 100% of the estimated travel expenses, daily allowances, and contingent costs to avoid personal financial hardship during official tour travel.

questions.question_english: A School Principal is summoned to another state to attend an official consultative meeting. The Principal decides to travel two days early to visit relatives before the meeting. According to Travelling Allowance Rules, how should the Daily Allowance (DA) be calculated?
options_english: DA is admissible for the entire period of absence including personal visits from headquarters
DA is admissible only for meeting days and necessary transit time
DA is completely forfeited because personal leave was combined with the tour
DA is paid at a reduced rate of 50% of the normal entitlement
questions.explanation_english: DA is admissible only for meeting days and necessary transit time Daily Allowance is strictly intended to cover expenses incurred while carrying out official duties away from headquarters. Combining private leave or personal visits with an official tour does not extend official entitlement. Therefore, Daily Allowance is admissible solely for the actual days spent attending the official meeting and the unavoidable transit time required for travel.
